items.title: Flight Gets Canceled After Toddler Stands In Seat, Delaying It Past Curfew
items.summary: A scheduled Porter Airlines flight from Victoria, British Columbia Canada to Toronto Pearson International was canceled on Thursday, August 6th, after it appears a child failed to wear their seatbelt and stood in the seat. This act of non-compliance pushed the flight past its curfew, meaning passengers became stuck until the flight could operate the next day.
